notes: List API prices; the experiment ran on subscriptions (Claude Max/Pro, ChatGPT Plus), so these are what the same tokens WOULD cost on the API — estimates, not invoices.
Claude cache_write priced at the 5-minute TTL rate (1.25x input); 1-hour writes cost 2x input, so the main-session share of Synergy is slightly underestimated.
OpenAI output_tokens already include reasoning tokens; reasoning is not charged separately.
